hypothesis: Extreme ETF share contraction combined with price dislocation and short-horizon stabilization predicts positive subsequent mean reversion because mechanically constrained order flow and liquidity pressure can exhaust before fundamental value changes.

primary_signal.schedule: weekly first trading day observation; platform executes Monday 10:30 using previous_date

event_study.episode_rule: For each ETF, keep only the first weekly signal within a 28-calendar-day shock episode.

coarse_grid.note: The grid is diagnostic only. Do not select the full-sample winner as a new baseline.

promotion_gate: positive 20-day incremental event return versus unconditional weekly ETF observations
same sign in at least three predeclared market phases
positive after removing top 5 percent contributing events
positive after matching on ordinary price reversal/drawdown/volatility
neighboring parameter configurations show a plateau rather than an isolated optimum
then pass portfolio cost/capacity/expanding-window out-of-sample tests
known_limits: China ETF redemptions can use in-kind delivery and cash substitution, so FUND_SHARE_DAILY contraction is a flow-pressure proxy, not direct proof that the fund sold underlying stocks.
ETF share redemption is only one form of institutional constraint and does not directly measure active mutual fund forced selling.
Redemption can be information-driven; the baseline has no fundamental-intact filter.
JoinQuant FUND_SHARE_DAILY availability and historical corrections must be audited before treating results as strict point-in-time evidence.
The local daily-open proxy will not exactly reproduce Monday 10:30 official backtest execution.

data_acceptance.historical_lifecycle_audit: The exported ETF master must contain lifecycle dates and at least one historically terminated ETF over the research era; otherwise stop and fix the master extraction before research.
data_acceptance.share_coverage_audit: Report first/last FUND_SHARE_DAILY date and non-null share observations per ETF; do not silently forward-fill across long gaps.
data_acceptance.tracking_pit_audit: Use max(pub_date, start_date) as the earliest effective tracking-target date and respect end_date.
